主要内容: On March 6, 2013, Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc. appointed Stephen Dunmead as Chief Operating Officer. Dunmead, who previously served as Executive Vice President and General Manager of OM Group's Specialties Division, brings extensive experience in global operations and management. He will not have an employment contract with the company and will be compensated with a base salary of $485,000 per year, a target annual incentive bonus of 80% of base salary, and a long-term incentive bonus targeted at 140% of base salary, payable in restricted stock. The company awarded him 10,000 shares of restricted stock with a four-year vesting period. Otto R. Herbst will continue as Executive Vice President, managing the paper business, while Wilfred A. Martinez will transition to Vice President, Research and Development effective March 31, 2013. The Form 8-K filing by Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc. on March 6, 2013, announced a change in senior management. The press release, attached as Exhibit 99.1, detailed the appointment of new senior management. The filing also noted that the terms of the change were consistent with those made available to all salaried employees. The report was signed by Jeffrey A. Cook, Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer & Treasurer, on behalf of the registrant. This filing reflects a corporate governance update related to leadership changes within the company.
